metadata.name: recsys-pipeline-architect
metadata.description: Design composable recommendation, ranking, and feed pipelines using the six-stage Source→Hydrator→Filter→Scorer→Selector→SideEffect framework popularized by xAI's open-sourced For You algorithm. Use this skill whenever the user is building any system that picks "the top K items for a (user, context)" — social feeds, content CMSs, RAG rerankers, task prioritizers, notification triage, search reranking, ad ranking.
